content: Hi Michael! I saw your portfolio includes FinTech companies. I'd love to discuss NovaPay's Series A round with you.
Hi Sarah! Absolutely, your traction looks impressive. Can we schedule a call next week to discuss the opportunity?
That would be great! I am free Tuesday or Thursday afternoon.
Let's do Thursday at 3pm EST. I will send a calendar invite. Could you share your deck beforehand?
Hi Michael, Priya here from CareConnect. I noticed Apex Ventures has invested in HealthTech before. Would love to connect!
Hi Priya! Yes, HealthTech is absolutely in our focus. Tell me more about CareConnect — what is your current MRR?
We are at $85K MRR, growing 20% month over month. Happy to share the full metrics deck!
Sarah, James here. Heard great things about NovaPay from a mutual connection. Would love to learn more about your vision.
James! Thanks so much. I would love to chat. Our focus is financial inclusion for gig workers — a massive underserved market.
